name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 8 visits over 82 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.4 days starting 2025-12-04, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 5.00 um. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
